Canonical BANC viewpoints as 4x4 rotation matrices

Source: R/xform.R
banc_rotation_matrices.Rd

A named list of userMatrix-style matrices used by banc_view() / banc_front_view() / banc_vnc_view() etc. and by banc_neuron_comparison_plot() to switch nat.ggplot::geom_neuron() between standard BANC viewpoints (main, side, front, vnc, vnc_side, brain_side). Exposed so users can compose their own multi-panel ggplots without re-deriving the matrices.

Usage

banc_rotation_matrices

Format

A named list of 4x4 numeric matrices.
